Executive c rber.
Mr. J. F. Moreno, a British subject, may be admitted to examination
for appointment in the classified service. The requirement of United
States citizenship is waived in view of the fact that for twvelve years he
wvas a clerk in the Diplomatic and Consular Services and is nowv temporarily
employed as a stenographer under the War Department and intends to
apply for naturalization.
